stem:
Meera measures the time taken by a simple pendulum in her school laboratory. She finds that the pendulum completes 30 full oscillations in 45 seconds.
What is the time period of the pendulum?

teacher.key_rationale: Time period = total time / number of oscillations = 45 s / 30 = 1.5 s. Option A is the trap for students who forget to divide by the number of oscillations; B divides the wrong way (30/45); D uses only the count of oscillations.
